procedure_text: (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；
procedure_summary: The methyl benzoate ester is cleaved with base to the sodium benzoate salt by the same procedure as an earlier worked example, leaving the benzylic bromide intact. The salt is obtained with its content stated but with no reagents, charges or conditions repeated here.
notes: Chinese text of the whole step is the single cross-reference sentence (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；, which is at once the heading and the procedure. The printed name straddles the p17 page break: line 497 ends at 苯, line 502 resumes at 甲酸钠盐；, and the continuation line carries a None token that is a page artifact of the enrichment, not patent text; it is removed from procedure_text. The EN convenience line 498 renders the truncated fragment as the free benzoic acid, while the Chinese completed across the break names the sodium salt (苯甲酸钠盐); this is an artifact of where the page cuts, not two different compounds, so translation_conflict is NOT raised and it is recorded here instead. NO PROCEDURE IS PRINTED IN THIS SECTION for this step: no reagent, no base, no solvent, no charge, no temperature, no time and no yield. Everything except the product identity and its 98.2 percent content lives in Example 1, so conditions_inherited is true and both cross_reference_unresolved and conditions_unresolved are raised; the Example 1 record was not available to this call, so the inheritance could not be resolved rather than confirmed. reaction_class: the document establishes this transformation as removal of the methyl ester from methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate to give the alkali metal benzoate with the benzylic bromide untouched (酯解/碱解 in the patent's own words). hydrolysis is the closest class in the allowed list; ester_formation is the wrong direction and salt_formation alone would describe only the counter-ion and lose the C-O bond cleavage. The product is nonetheless a salt. methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate is emitted as the reactant on the strength of the route the document establishes and of line 509, which names it as the basis of the yield; it is in A1 for this section with no quantity, so no a1_missing_compound is raised. precursor_step is null: nothing in the registry produces the methyl ester, and the reference to Example 1 is a reference to a PROCEDURE, not a statement that Example 1's product was charged here, so writing Example 1::Step 1 as a precursor would assert a material link the text does not make. The linkage:cross_section_linked tag records the procedural reference. No scheme is drawn for step (1) in this section, which is why Example 13 carries one drawing where Examples 1 to 12 carry two.

conditions.ph_target_stage: workup acidification, after solvent stripping and dissolution of the residue in water

steps: strip the solvent under negative pressure
add water to the kettle residue and stir to dissolve
add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3
washes: water rinse of the filtered solid
workup.filtration: filtered, then the solid rinsed with water and dried

purification: product precipitated by acidification to pH 3, then filtered, rinsed with water and dried

compounds.addition_profile: added to the reaction flask in eight portions, total feeding time 3h, kettle temperature held at 5℃
charged to the kettle with the solvent and the base before stirring was started
charged to the kettle with the solvent and the alcohol before stirring was started
added to the kettle residue after solvent stripping and stirred to dissolve; water also used to rinse the filtered solid, volume not printed
concentrated acid added dropwise to the dissolved residue until pH 3

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF、11.8g 2-四氢呋喃甲醇(99％，0.115mol)和5.4g氢氧化钠(96％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应6h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.3％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率89.1％。
procedure_summary: The benzoate salt from the preceding step is fed in portions into a cold solution of tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol and sodium hydroxide in dimethylformamide, where the alkoxide generated in situ displaces the benzylic bromide to give the ether. The solvent is stripped under negative pressure, the residue is dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated free acid is filtered, rinsed with water, dried and assayed by liquid chromatography.
notes: Chinese heading (line 504): (2)2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示： (preparation of the target acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation). The heading is kept here per rule 2 and procedure_text carries the procedure paragraph only. REACTOR: the same sentence says the charge goes 向反应釜中 (into the reaction kettle) and that the benzoate salt is added 加入反应瓶中 (into the reaction flask), and 控制釜温 (kettle temperature) is what is controlled. reactor_type is recorded as the kettle, which the temperature control and the negative-pressure stripping both refer to; the single appearance of 反应瓶 is recorded here as printed and not reconciled. Volume of the kettle is not printed. STIRRING: 开动搅拌 says stirring was started without naming the type, so stirring.type is left null. TEMPERATURE AND TIME: 控制釜温在5℃ is the controlled reaction temperature; the 3h is the total feeding time of the benzoate salt and belongs to that compound's addition_profile, so time_h is the 6h hold after feeding. No cooling method is named for holding 5℃. ONE POT: the alcohol and sodium hydroxide are charged together and the alkoxide is generated in situ and never isolated, so the deprotonation is not given a record of its own and is_one_pot is false. This section performs no separate alkoxide preparation, which is why it has two steps and not three. ACIDIFICATION: the concentrated hydrochloric acid is a workup acidification of the carboxylate to the free acid, not a reagent of the substitution; it is recorded in workup with ph_target 3, and conditions.ph_value carries the same 3 with ph_target_stage naming the workup. HCl is also drawn under the arrow at line 506 alongside THFA and NaOH. DRAWING: the scheme at line 506 draws exactly one arrow, from the sodium benzoate salt to the target acid, with THFA, NaOH and HCl on the arrow. Both the metal (sodium) and all three arrow reagents agree with the prose, so drawing_text_conflict is NOT raised for this section. The arrow omits the DMF solvent and the workup water, which are in the prose; this is ordinary scheme abbreviation of a solvent rather than a disagreement about what was charged, so reagent_written_not_drawn is not raised and is recorded here. ARITHMETIC: every printed mass/mole/content triple in this step closes. 2-tetrahydrofuran methanol 11.8 g at 99 percent is 11.68 g, which at 102.13 is 0.1144 mol against 0.115 mol printed. Sodium hydroxide 5.4 g at 96 percent is 5.18 g, which at 40.00 is 0.1296 mol against 0.13 mol printed. The product 32.6 g at 95.3 percent content is 31.07 g, which at 348.81 is 0.0891 mol, exactly 89.1 percent of the 0.1 mol of benzoate salt charged. So mass_balance_implausible and molar_mass_inconsistent are NOT raised. BUT the printed 89.1 percent is stated as a TWO-step yield calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate, and the arithmetic above reproduces it as a ONE-step yield on the 0.1 mol of salt charged here. The two readings coincide only if step (1) were quantitative and charged at exactly 0.1 mol of the methyl ester; this section prints no charge for step (1), so the stated basis cannot be checked. That is why cross_reference_unresolved is true on this step even though the material link to step (1) is confirmed: the material reference 步骤(1)制备得到的 resolves, the yield basis does not. The number is recorded as printed in product_yield_pct. CONTINUITY: step (1) prints no isolated mass or mole figure at all, so this step's 0.1 mol input cannot be compared with step (1)'s output and scale_discontinuity is neither confirmed nor excluded; it is not raised because no discontinuity was observed. SCALE: no mass is printed for the benzoate salt, only 0.1 mol; the alcohol at 11.8 g and the product at 32.6 g both put the step in the lab range. (RS) is kept from the prose; the drawn product at line 506 carries no stereo bond and none was added. process_control is left null: 反应完毕 names no monitoring method, and the HPLC is a post-isolation assay of the product, recorded as product_purity_method.
